name: io.github.hristovdimitri2-hub/kristo-intelligence
title: Kristo Intelligence
description: Pay-per-call DeFi intelligence for AI agents on Base — x402, USDC, no keys.

pricing.note: Every unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the canonical x402 challenge; the amount in that response is the price. No free tier, no signup, no API keys.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Read-only; no parameters. Returns the live Base market snapshot: aggregated activity, daily request/sales counters, the official agent catalog, and real-time market data (CoinGecko, DEXScreener, Fear & Greed). Use it for market context and price/indicator lookups; use get_onchain_sales for paid-call revenue and get_bot_status for integration health.

tools.name: get_onchain_sales
tools.description: Read-only; no parameters. Returns the real on-chain payment history to this service's fee receiver on Base: total_volume_usd, total_sales, by_token, up to 100 history rows (tx hash, payer, amount, block, timestamp), source="real_blockchain". Authoritative for provable revenue. wallet_address, usdc_balance and market_data are convenience copies for one-call use; get_bot_status owns wallet state and get_market_stats owns market data.

tools.name: get_bot_status
tools.description: Read-only; no parameters. Returns the service's Telegram integration status as JSON: telegram_bot_running, telegram_token_configured, last_heartbeat, uptime_started, messages_sent, active_users, commands_processed, vip_invites_sent, and the full wallet state. Authoritative for wallet state, and for whether this service's monitoring is alive: check the heartbeat before trusting other outputs. get_onchain_sales carries a two-field copy of the wallet, and get_market_stats owns market data.

tools.name: get_trading_signal
tools.description: Read-only; no parameters. Returns this service's flagship trading-agent signals for ETH, ONDO, KAITO and DEGEN: action, confidence, price_usd and the model's reasoning. Its own measured record is public and losing: /public/signals/history — read it before acting on a signal. Use it when you need a directional call rather than raw market data; use get_whale_flow for large-transfer flow and get_arbitrage_opportunities for cross-DEX spreads.

tools.name: get_whale_flow
tools.description: Read-only; no parameters. Returns network-wide USDC whale flow on Base: transfers of $5M or more, refreshed every 60 seconds, with labelled counterparties. Use it to see where size is moving; use get_trading_signal for directional calls or get_market_stats for broad context.

tools.name: get_arbitrage_opportunities
tools.description: Read-only; no parameters. Returns live cross-DEX arbitrage spreads on Base, refreshed every 60 seconds. Use it for executable price gaps between venues; use get_market_stats for aggregate prices or get_trading_signal for directional calls.

tools.name: verify_seller_receiver
tools.description: Read-only; REQUIRES `receiver`. Audits ANY receiver's incoming USDC on Base: distinct payers, repeat payers, concentration, probes vs customers. Decides whether a seller is safe to pay. Reports partial/failed, never a zero it did not measure.
